query_scope_rule: Run each exact per-source query file only against the source/entry in that row. The requested per-format aggregate .jsonl files concatenate several repository scopes and are source-key indexes only; do not pass them to a single capture invocation. queries.jsonl is the neutral kube/crossplane scope only.
neutral_git_rule: Initialize from the frozen tracked files and symlinks with the identity JSON origin/fixed_git/commit_message, excluding .git from any tracked product files. Require the expected input commit and byte hashes.
public_source_rule: The helper fetches the unchanged exact public infra pins. Retained local source/ bytes, complete Git trees and per-blob SHA1/SHA256 permit independent review; they need not be vendored into tracked product files. Artifact inputs from public CI must match these same immutable hashes.
capture_rule: Use only existing bounded public CI capture helper, full CLI status/export, all source-selected context/search/up/down trace results and same-scope HTTP byte parity. CAPTURED is not acceptance.
